headline: MultiChoice Slashes DStv Kenya Prices as Canal+ Competition Looms
summary: MultiChoice will restructure and lower prices for its DStv packages in Kenya starting November 5, offering plans from $6 to $56 per month.
why: Intensifying competition in African pay-TV markets forces operators to adjust pricing tiers to defend subscriber bases.

impacts.name: MultiChoice Group
impacts.why: Price cuts may defend subscriber numbers but pressure average revenue per user.
